payload.title: Docs overhaul: current-state documentation, not build history. Diataxis framework (the standard): tutorials, how-to guides, reference, explanation. Strip process narrative (chunk logs, phase history, cold-start report) from README and docs; document what the app IS: how it is built, how to use, how it works. README: quick start, real example, key concepts. Mermaid diagrams with correct fences so GitHub renders them. Simplified technical English throughout. T-7
